look: Quartzback Direwolf, a C-rank GKOM variant from the Quartzbacks family: pony-sized dire wolf with a mane of frozen quartz. Family anatomy: wolves with frost-quartz spines along the back and pale icy fur. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystal plates over shoulders, back and limbs; about a third of the body crystallised; the crystals are frost-white quartz. A fist-sized GKOM core orb, deep red with internal light, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Water: aqua, deep blue and pearl accents, clear ribbons of water, bubbles and moonlit spray
